name: Toledo
takeaway: Toledo gas is Columbia Gas of Ohio. NOAC electric term ended May 2026 and is now rollover. NOAC has run a gas aggregation program (Constellation through May 2024) but paused it in 2024 pending a price under its threshold. Current NOAC gas status is unconfirmed.
hook: Toledo's NOAC electric term ended in May. Gas here is Columbia Gas of Ohio. Do you know if NOAC restarted its gas program, or are those accounts on Columbia's standard rate?
notes: Toledo, Lucas County. Columbia Gas of Ohio gas distribution (company PUCO filing cites ~145,000 Lucas County customers; Wood County suburbs not separately confirmed). NOAC ran an opt-out gas aggregation with Constellation through May 2024; its May 2024 FAQ says a new gas program would start only if a price offer came in under the coalition's threshold. Current NOAC gas status unconfirmed. Verify with the city or NOAC.
